name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success Manager | Account Retention, Expansion & AI-Driven Execution
summary: Client Success and Account Management professional with 15+ years owning strategic B2B relationships from deployment through renewal and expansion. Built a reseller partner book to ~94% retention through disciplined account health tracking and proactive risk management, and carries direct financial-services exposure from managing a banking-industry client and pursuing a major banking prospect to finalist stage. Runs an AI-driven business today (Solenzo), using AI tools by default to move faster on account strategy, reporting, and client communication, the same instinct this role asks for.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals and challenges, then developing a tailored strategy against them.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with each client's growth goals.
Run day-to-day delivery for B2B clients end to end, from deployment through ongoing optimization, managing operational needs and driving them to their goals on complex SaaS platforms.
Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for clients, treating AI as the default way to move faster on strategy, reporting, and outreach rather than a separate initiative.
Build performance dashboards tracking funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights and market-informed recommendations to clients acting as executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments for each account.

Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs that kept clients current on their own performance and market position.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention — Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer-health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value and proactively resolve issues before they became churn risk.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation-management solutions.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and direct interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage in that deal.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals and initiatives.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
